business_problem: IMAI needed generative models capable of producing realistic, visually consistent assets for demanding film and advertising workflows, and sought to build creative platforms and AI-powered solutions for customers.
solution_summary: IMAI combines BytePlus model capabilities with its IMGENTIC production platform to create commercial image, video, and audio content. Dreamina Seedance 2.5 supports AI video production and the development of tools for professional creative workflows; Dola Seedream and BytePlus Cloud contribute to the foundation for new software and AI-powered solutions. BytePlus Effects is also listed among the capabilities IMAI uses. IMGENTIC brings image, video, and audio creation into one workspace where users can generate content and keep their work together. IMAI has integrated BytePlus models into its point-of-sale ecosystem for storefront operations in Thailand, while commercial production houses can connect through direct API integrations or custom system development. The source does not describe input-data handling, model hosting, persistence, or the underlying API design, so no specific data or serving architecture is asserted.
